name: Buzzbox 411
summary: Along Darkshore’s coast, Buzzbox 411 needs thresher eyes to return to service. This Alliance errand comes through an eccentric, intoxicated gnome inventor, Wizbang Cranktoggle, who works through a mechanical relay network.

sections.title: Voice Through the Static
sections.body: After you help repair Buzzbox 827 farther south, gnome inventor Wizbang Cranktoggle’s voice crackles through the mechanical transmitter again. From somewhere safely out of sight, he directs adventurers north along Darkshore’s mist-laden beach to a damaged terminal called Buzzbox 411. His transmissions break with hiccups and muttered praise for crawler wine. He says local aquatic predators carry what his coastal apparatus needs to keep working.

sections.title: Eyes Beneath the Surf
sections.body: To restore Buzzbox 411, thresher eyes must be fed into its waiting hatch. Darkshore threshers, aggressive marine beasts, prowl the shallows off Auberdine, and their eyes have the properties Wizbang says are needed to recalibrate the device. The eyes jolt the apparatus back into operation, and the line opens for another assignment, delivered in an even slurrier voice.

faq.answer: Buzzbox 411 is a mechanical transmitter north of Auberdine along the Darkshore shoreline. It belongs to an experimental listening and research network maintained by Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome engineer.

Wizbang Cranktoggle is an eccentric gnome tinkerer who speaks remotely through the Buzzbox network. He spends his field research heavily enjoying crawler wine and relies on passing adventurers to collect animal parts in hazardous places.

faq.q: Why does a machine need Thresher Eyes?
faq.answer: Gnomish engineering often blends bizarre organic matter with mechanical components for unorthodox tasks. Wizbang says thresher eyes are vital to repairing Buzzbox 411, whether for optical sensors or biological research.
Buzzbox 411 is on the beach in Darkshore, north of the night elf settlement of Auberdine.

faq.q: Where do I find Darkshore Threshers?
faq.answer: Darkshore threshers swim in the coastal waters off Auberdine and along nearby shores. Swim out past the surf line to find them easily.

faq.q: What happens after Buzzbox 411 is fixed?
faq.answer: Once the machine hums back to life, Wizbang Cranktoggle thanks you through the static, drinks again, and asks if you will fix his next machine, Buzzbox 323.

angles.text: Wizbang Cranktoggle shows the eccentric gnomish approach to fieldwork: bold invention, peculiar component choices, and leaving dangerous swimming to whoever happens by.
Thresher eyes used to calibrate a mechanical transmitter show the boundary-pushing methods of unconventional tinkerers.
Auberdine’s sentinels watch Darkshore’s waters, though they typically leave peculiar gnomish contraptions on the shoreline to their own devices.
